description: 与 W3L 相同（约 100 词回答，max_tokens 160），但请求里 seed 为 null，thinker 可以走提前发射（实验 11）。

texts: Explain in about 100 words how a CPU cache speeds up programs, as if teaching a new student.
In about 100 words, describe how a train timetable is planned for a busy city line.
Describe in about 100 words what happens, step by step, when you send an email.
In about 100 words, explain why the sky looks blue during the day and red at sunset.
Give an explanation of about 100 words of how a refrigerator keeps food cold.
In about 100 words, explain how a vaccine teaches the immune system to recognize a virus.
